description: An old_string that isn't in the file (wrong quotes) gets the closest lines back; the retry lands. Edits across six files.
prompt: Add a required `email: string` field to the User interface in src/types.ts, and show it in greet: "Hi Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>". makeUser (src/factory.ts) takes the email as a third argument. Wherever a user is created without a known address, use `<id>@example.com`.

deliberate.why: marv-rs refuses edit_file and write_file on an existing file the session hasn't read, or that changed since it read it: the scripted model also reads `src/greet.ts`, `src/seed.ts`, `src/csv.ts` before editing (script.marv-rs.jsonl), and nothing else changes. The files and exit code are Marv's.
